<style>
footer.footer {
  display: none !important;
}

.quarto-title-block,
#title-block-header {
  display: none !important;
}

/* This full-screen project sits flush under the site navbar. Quarto/Cosmo
   otherwise leaves a small white strip and bottom rule under the header. */
#quarto-header {
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  border-bottom: 0 !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  background: #f8f9fa !important;
}

#quarto-header .navbar,
#quarto-header > nav {
  margin: 0 !important;
  border-bottom: 0 !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

/* Use the same full-width Quarto pattern as the portfolio's other
   full-screen visualizations. column-screen handles the page grid; avoid
   forcing widths on Quarto's internal grid wrappers. */
#quarto-content,
main.content,
.page-columns {
  margin-top: 0 !important;
  padding-top: 0 !important;
}

html.network-project-app,
body.network-project-app {
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
}

.network-project-root {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: none;
  margin: -7px 0 0 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.network-project-nav {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0 0 auto 0;
  z-index: 20;
  height: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.network-project-title-block {
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px;
  left: 14px;
  width: min(520px, calc(100vw - 28px));
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(205,210,216,.82);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.84);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(24,31,39,.08);
  backdrop-filter: blur(9px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(9px);
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.network-project-brand {
  display: block;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.15;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.network-project-subtitle {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 2px;
  color: #666d76;
  font-size: 9.5px;
  line-height: 1.3;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.network-project-tabs {
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px;
  right: 14px;
  display: flex;
  gap: 5px;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 5px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(205,210,216,.82);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.80);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(24,31,39,.08);
  backdrop-filter: blur(9px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(9px);
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.network-project-tab {
  border: 1px solid #d8dce2;
  background: #fff;
  color: #30343a;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 750;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.network-project-tab:hover {
  background: #f1f3f5;
}

.network-project-tab.is-active {
  background: #17191c;
  color: #fff;
  border-color: #17191c;
}

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .network-project-title-block {
    top: 8px;
    left: 12px;
    width: calc(100vw - 24px);
  }

  .network-project-subtitle {
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .network-project-tabs {
    top: 60px;
    left: 12px;
    right: auto;
    max-width: calc(100vw - 24px);
    overflow-x: auto;
    scrollbar-width: none;
  }

  .network-project-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .network-project-title-block {
    top: 6px;
    left: 8px;
    width: calc(100vw - 16px);
    padding: 7px 9px;
  }

  .network-project-brand {
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .network-project-subtitle {
    font-size: 8.5px;
  }

  .network-project-tabs {
    top: 56px;
    left: 8px;
    max-width: calc(100vw - 16px);
  }

  .network-project-tab {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    padding: 6px 9px;
    font-size: 10px;
  }
}

.network-visual-shell {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100dvh;
  min-height: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #ffffff;
}

.network-visual-shell iframe {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: #ffffff;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.45s ease;
}

.network-visual-shell.is-loaded iframe {
  opacity: 1;
}

.network-loader {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 46%, rgba(214,181,74,0.08), transparent 28%),
    #f7f8fa;
  transition: opacity 0.35s ease, visibility 0.35s ease;
}

.network-visual-shell.is-loaded .network-loader {
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.loader-inner {
  display: grid;
  justify-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
  color: #444a52;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
}

.loader-network {
  width: 116px;
  height: 78px;
}

.loader-network svg {
  display: block;
  width: 116px;
  height: 78px;
  overflow: visible;
}

.loader-edge {
  stroke: #c8cdd3;
  stroke-width: 1.5;
  stroke-linecap: round;
}

.loader-node {
  transform-box: fill-box;
  transform-origin: center;
  animation: networkPulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.loader-node.left {
  animation-delay: 0.18s;
}

.loader-node.right {
  animation-delay: 0.36s;
}

.loader-node.top {
  animation-delay: 0.54s;
}

@keyframes networkPulse {
  0%, 100% { transform: scale(0.88); opacity: 0.62; }
  50% { transform: scale(1.2); opacity: 1; }
}

@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .network-visual-shell {
    height: 100dvh;
    min-height: 0;
  }

}
</style>

```{=html}
<div class="column-screen network-project-root">
<div class="network-project-nav" aria-label="Project sections">

<div class="loader-network" aria-hidden="true">
<svg viewBox="0 0 116 78" role="presentation" focusable="false">
<line class="loader-edge" x1="58" y1="41" x2="18" y2="61"></line>
<line class="loader-edge" x1="58" y1="41" x2="99" y2="61"></line>
<line class="loader-edge" x1="58" y1="41" x2="98" y2="14"></line>
<circle class="loader-node center" cx="58" cy="41" r="8" fill="#d6b54a"></circle>
<circle class="loader-node left" cx="18" cy="61" r="6.5" fill="#2f6fdb"></circle>
<circle class="loader-node right" cx="99" cy="61" r="6.5" fill="#d64b4b"></circle>
<rect class="loader-node top" x="92" y="8" width="12" height="12" rx="3" fill="#667a70"></rect>
</svg>
</div>
<div id="network-loader-message">Loading congressional stock data…</div>
</div>
</div>
<iframe id="congress-network-frame" src="https://strokeofluck.github.io/congressional-stock-network-2025/?embed=1" title="Interactive Congressional Stock Trading Network" loading="eager" allowfullscreen></iframe>
</div>
</div>
```

<script>
(function () {
  const shell = document.getElementById("network-visual-shell");
  const frame = document.getElementById("congress-network-frame");
  const message = document.getElementById("network-loader-message");

  if (!shell || !frame) return;

  document.documentElement.classList.add("network-project-app");
  document.body.classList.add("network-project-app");

  function fitShellToViewport() {
    const shellTop = Math.max(0, shell.getBoundingClientRect().top);
    const availableHeight = Math.max(1, Math.floor(window.innerHeight - shellTop));
    shell.style.height = availableHeight + "px";
  }

  function scheduleShellFit() {
    window.requestAnimationFrame(function() {
      fitShellToViewport();
      window.setTimeout(fitShellToViewport, 120);
    });
  }

  scheduleShellFit();
  window.addEventListener("resize", scheduleShellFit);
  window.addEventListener("orientationchange", scheduleShellFit);

  const projectTabs = Array.from(
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-network-page]")
  );

  projectTabs.forEach(function(button) {
    button.addEventListener("click", function() {
      const page = button.getAttribute("data-network-page");

      projectTabs.forEach(function(tab) {
        tab.classList.toggle("is-active", tab === button);
      });

      if (frame.contentWindow) {
        frame.contentWindow.postMessage(
          {
            type: "congress-network-navigate",
            page: page
          },
          window.location.origin
        );
      }

      scheduleShellFit();
    });
  });

  let finished = false;
  const startedAt = performance.now();
  const minimumLoaderMs = 1200;

  function revealNetwork() {
    if (finished) return;
    finished = true;

    const elapsed = performance.now() - startedAt;
    const remaining = Math.max(0, minimumLoaderMs - elapsed);

    window.setTimeout(function () {
      shell.classList.add("is-loaded");
    }, remaining);
  }

  frame.addEventListener("load", function () {
    if (message) {
      message.textContent = "Arranging politicians, stocks, and committees…";
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener("message", function (event) {
    if (event.origin !== window.location.origin) return;

    if (
      event.data &&
      event.data.type === "congress-network-ready"
    ) {
      if (message) {
        message.textContent = "Network ready";
      }
      revealNetwork();
    }
  });

  /* Safety fallback in case a browser suppresses the ready message. */
  window.setTimeout(function () {
    if (!finished) {
      if (message) {
        message.textContent = "Opening network…";
      }
      revealNetwork();
    }
  }, 20000);
})();
</script>
